title: E-commerce store backend with payment integration
raw_description: I need a backend for my online shop. Should handle products, orders, and let customers pay online. Nothing too fancy.
scope: REST API for product catalog, cart, checkout, order management; integration with a payment gateway (Stripe-equivalent); basic admin endpoints for inventory.

title: Mobile app for local gym class bookings
raw_description: Want an app where people can see gym classes and book a spot. Should work on iPhone and Android.
scope: Cross-platform mobile app with class schedule, booking flow, push notifications for reminders, and a simple admin panel for the gym owner to manage classes.

title: Web scraper for competitor price monitoring
raw_description: Need something that checks 5 competitor websites daily and tells me if their prices changed.
scope: Scheduled scraper for 5 target sites, price-change detection, email/Telegram alert on change, simple dashboard showing price history.

title: Internal data pipeline for sales reporting
raw_description: We have sales data in 3 different spreadsheets and want it combined into one dashboard automatically every week.
scope: ETL pipeline pulling from 3 spreadsheet sources, data cleaning/normalization, weekly automated run, dashboard with key sales metrics.

title: WordPress plugin for appointment scheduling
raw_description: Need a plugin so customers can book appointments on my WordPress site. Should be simple.
scope: Custom WordPress plugin: calendar view, appointment booking form, email confirmations, admin settings page for available time slots.

title: AI customer-support chatbot for e-commerce site
raw_description: Want a chatbot that can answer common questions about orders and shipping, like a real assistant.
scope: LLM-based chatbot integrated into existing website, connected to order-status API, handles FAQs, escalates to human when uncertain.

title: CI/CD automation for existing backend project
raw_description: We deploy manually right now and it's a mess. Want it automated.
scope: Set up CI/CD pipeline: automated tests on PR, staging deploy on merge, production deploy on tag, basic rollback capability.

title: Convert Figma design into working web app
raw_description: I have a complete design in Figma, just need someone to build it exactly as shown.
scope: Pixel-accurate implementation of a ~12-screen Figma design as a responsive web app, no backend logic beyond static forms.

title: Inventory management API for small warehouse
raw_description: Need to track stock levels across 2 warehouse locations, nothing complicated.
scope: REST API for SKU tracking across 2 locations, stock-transfer logging, low-stock alerts, basic reporting endpoint.

title: Full social media app like Instagram
raw_description: Want a full social app, photo sharing, stories, DMs, like Instagram basically. Simple MVP is fine.
scope: Photo/video feed, stories, direct messaging, following system, push notifications, content moderation basics — full social platform MVP.

title: PDF invoice generator integrated with accounting software
raw_description: We manually create invoices in Word right now, want it automated and connected to our accounting tool.
scope: Automated PDF invoice generation from order data, integration with existing accounting software's API, template customization.

title: Real-time multiplayer trivia game app
raw_description: Like Kahoot but our own branded version, people join with a code and answer questions live.
scope: Real-time multiplayer quiz app: room codes, live question sync, scoring, leaderboard, host dashboard.

title: Scraper + AI summarizer for news articles
raw_description: Want to pull articles from a few news sites and get AI summaries automatically, daily digest style.
scope: Scheduled scraper for ~10 news sources, LLM-based summarization, daily digest generation and delivery via email.

title: API integration between CRM and email marketing tool
raw_description: Need our CRM contacts to automatically sync with our email marketing platform.
scope: Two-way sync between CRM API and email marketing platform API, conflict handling, scheduled sync job, error logging/alerts.

title: Enterprise-grade ERP system for manufacturing company
raw_description: We need a complete ERP, inventory, HR, accounting, production planning, everything in one system, budget is tight though.
scope: Full ERP: inventory management, HR module, accounting module, production planning, multi-user permissions, reporting suite.

title: Salon appointment booking app
raw_description: یه اپلیکیشن برای رزرو نوبت آرایشگاه می‌خوام، ساده باشه، مشتری بتونه روز و ساعت خالی رو ببینه و نوبت بگیره.
scope: Cross-platform mobile app for salon appointment booking: view available slots, book/cancel appointments, push notification reminders, simple admin panel for the salon owner to manage schedule.

title: Restaurant table reservation and ordering app
raw_description: می‌خوام یه اپ برای رستورانم بسازم که مشتری‌ها بتونن میز رزرو کنن و منو رو ببینن و سفارش بدن.
scope: Mobile app for table reservations plus digital menu and in-app ordering, kitchen-facing order queue, basic table-availability management for restaurant staff.

title: On-demand home cleaning service booking app
raw_description: یه اپلیکیشن مثل اسنپ می‌خوام ولی برای رزرو نیروی نظافت منزل، مشتری درخواست بده و نیروی نزدیک بهش وصل بشه.
scope: On-demand service-matching mobile app: customer submits a cleaning request, nearby available workers are matched and notified, in-app status tracking and rating after job completion.

title: Persian-language customer support chatbot
raw_description: برای سایت فروشگاهیم یه ربات چت فارسی می‌خوام که بتونه به سوالای مشتری‌ها درباره سفارش و ارسال جواب بده.
scope: LLM-based Persian-language chatbot embedded on an e-commerce site, connected to order-status data, handles shipping/order FAQs, escalates unclear questions to a human agent.

title: Online tutoring platform with video calls
raw_description: یه پلتفرم برای آموزش آنلاین می‌خوام که معلم و دانش‌آموز بتونن کلاس آنلاین با ویدیو داشته باشن و برنامه کلاسی هم مدیریت بشه.
scope: Web/mobile platform connecting tutors and students: scheduling, video-call integration for live classes, class history and materials sharing, payment per session.

title: Grocery store inventory and barcode scanning app
raw_description: برای سوپرمارکتم یه برنامه می‌خوام که با اسکن بارکد موجودی انبار رو مدیریت کنه و وقتی جنسی کم شد بهم خبر بده.
scope: Mobile app with barcode scanning for stock management: add/remove inventory by scan, low-stock alerts, basic sales reporting for a small grocery store.

title: Telegram bot for online store order management
raw_description: یه ربات تلگرام برای فروشگاه اینستاگرامیم می‌خوام که سفارش‌ها رو از طریق پیام بگیره و موجودی رو مدیریت کنه.
scope: Telegram bot for an Instagram-based shop: receive orders via chat, manage product inventory, automated order-confirmation messages to customers.

title: Real estate listing and search app
raw_description: یه اپلیکیشن آگهی ملک می‌خوام شبیه دیوار ولی فقط برای شهر خودمون، با فیلتر قیمت و منطقه.
scope: Regional real-estate listing mobile app: post/browse property listings, filter by price/area/type, contact-agent flow, image gallery per listing.

title: Gym and fitness class management system
raw_description: برای باشگاهم یه سیستم می‌خوام که اعضا بتونن کلاس‌ها رو ببینن، رزرو کنن و اشتراکشون رو مدیریت کنن.
scope: Mobile app for gym members: view/book classes, manage membership subscription status, attendance check-in, admin panel for class and member management.

title: Persian OCR document digitization tool
raw_description: یه ابزار می‌خوام که بتونه از روی عکس سند فارسی، متنشو دربیاره و توی اکسل ذخیره کنه.
scope: Persian-language OCR pipeline: extract text from scanned/photographed Persian documents, structure extracted fields, export to spreadsheet format.
